reviewContext.userProblem: music-things-airwindows holds the Airwindows framework and batch 1 (110 plugins, merged at d1199ca). The next 110 plugins of the Behringer KICK/IGNITE bundled Airwindows set (kick-airwindows-set.txt lines 111-220, DitherMeTimbers .. Pop2) are not ported yet. In batch 1 the largest plugins were skipped or stubbed in two consecutive waves (BigAmp left as an unregistered stub, Ditherbox never written).
requiredOutcomes: All 110 plugins on kick-airwindows-set.txt lines 111-220 are ported, registered in batch2 GROUPS (34 groups in kick order) and listed by catalog(); tests/catalog_batch2.rs asserts the exact ordered 110-name slice after DitherMeDiskers.

Every plugin has a parity test in tests/parity_batch2_gNN.rs against fixtures from the pinned upstream b110fac3991fff7c4655cc2d25d6a3e221f9799c, with class bounds (Libm <= 1e-6) and the measured max-abs recorded.
No .rs file under crates/airwindows/src/plugins/batch2 reaches 1000 lines; the 14 oversized plugins are module directories.
Final gates: workspace nextest --all-features, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check, wasm32 build. Full nextest is blocked by Q1 until the operator acts.
nonGoals: No edits to batch1/, batch3/, framework files (lib.rs, effect.rs, params.rs, dither.rs, rand.rs, display.rs, registry.rs, plugins/mod.rs), shared tests (catalog.rs, no_alloc.rs, batch1_complete.rs, fixture_budget.rs, stimulus_checksum.rs), tests/common, generate.sh/driver.cpp/prelude.h, root README, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, Cargo manifests or Cargo.lock.
No edits to design-behringer-oss-ports.md, the batch-1 dispatch manifest or design-docs/user-qa/README.md.
ab2-99-integration edits no source; repairs route back to the owning plan.
constraints: Port only from pinned upstream airwindows @ b110fac3991fff7c4655cc2d25d6a3e221f9799c (MIT), plugins/LinuxVST/src/<Name>/; keep upstream copyright headers; never read Music Tribe AGPL code.
Port the processReplacing float path including fpd dither, seeded through the existing rand/dither helpers.
Group plans hold at most 8 plugins; each of the 14 oversized plugins (Proc > 1000 lines) has its own plan and a module directory; every .rs file stays under 1000 lines.
Every listed plugin must be fully ported, registered and parity-tested; a stub, unregistered module, skipped plugin or ignored/weakened parity test is a plan failure, not a deferral.

W2 plans never gate on crate-wide clippy, full nextest, cargo fmt --check or wasm32; their gates are cargo check, their own parity tests, own-file rustfmt, the own-file clippy grep, line counts, ENTRY counts, the no-stub grep and the dead_code grep (common section 9). Only ab2-99-integration runs the crate-wide gates.
Each plan uses CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=tmp/airwindows-batch2/<planId>/target; evidence under tmp/airwindows-batch2/<planId> (gitignored).

Keep the shared crate compiling: declare a module early with a narrow #[allow(dead_code)], add its ENTRY and remove the allow only when complete; bounded wait on sibling breakage (common sections 5.6 and 8).
Workers edit only their own writePaths and never run tree-rewriting git commands.
designDecisionsAndRationale: 34 groups in kick-list order (design section 2): every oversized plugin is a singleton group so it gets its own plan and directory while catalog() order stays kick order.
ab2-00-scaffold pre-creates batch2/mod.rs with all 34 group modules, all 220 fixtures, generate_batch2.sh and catalog_batch2.rs, so no W2 plan touches a shared file (design sections 3, 4 and 6).
A new generate_batch2.sh instead of editing generate.sh, because generate.sh is hardcoded to batch 1 and must stay byte-stable; shim changes are append-only (design section 4).
catalog_batch2.rs asserts the exact ordered 110-name slice after DitherMeDiskers, fixture presence and parity coverage, so a stub or skip fails the batch (design section 6).
Only ab2-99-integration runs crate-wide clippy, full nextest, fmt --check and wasm32, avoiding the batch-1 shared-crate gate deadlock (design section 7).
PocketVerbs is split into ordered per-reverb-type subtasks and is registered only when every type is ported (design section 3).
intentionalTradeoffs: ab2-99 stays Blocked (Q1) for the full-nextest criterion until the operator edits or authorizes edits to tests/batch1_complete.rs and tests/fixture_budget.rs; the filtered nextest is the passing gate meanwhile.
ab2-00 keeps broad batch2 src and fixture writePaths for harness-escalation follow-ups during W2; those follow-ups should stay within tools/vst-shim and generate_batch2.sh.
Selector branches the fixtures never reach get only a mode-sweep smoke test (finite output, no panic), not a parity claim.
Each plan uses its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under its evidence directory, trading disk space for lock independence across about 30 parallel plans.
supportedEdgeCases: Batch 3 merged or not: catalog_batch2 locates the 110-name slice after DitherMeDiskers, and batch-3 entries follow Pop2.
Harness or shim defect found during W2: plugin marked BLOCKED-HARNESS, fix routed to ab2-00 additively, owning plan regenerates only its own group fixtures (common section 10).
Sibling compile breakage during W2: one retry, then a logged blocker; the plan stays Blocked (sibling <planId>) if it persists at completion.
Large-state plugins allocate arrays above 4096 elements as Box<[T]> in the constructor; the shared no_alloc test covers process, set_param and reset.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Cross-host libm calibration; the acceptance host is aarch64-apple-darwin.
Root README totals and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md updates (operator, after merging batches 2 and 3).
Fixing the shared tests batch1_complete.rs and fixture_budget.rs without the operator's Q1 answer.
openQuestions: Q1 (design-docs/user-qa/pending-airwindows-batch2.md): shared tests batch1_complete.rs and fixture_budget.rs fail once batch 2 lands; ab2-99 reports Blocked (Q1) until the operator applies or authorizes the minimal edits.
residualDesignFindings: S3-L1 (low): upstream line counts for Logical4 and NonlinearSpace differ by one from the issue text; no impact.
S3-L2 (low): the scaffold lacked an own-file clippy gate; added as ab2-00 command 7.
residualRisks: Q1 open: the ab2-99 full-nextest criterion is blocked until the operator acts.
Per-plugin pitfall hints in plans are unverified against the pinned sources; the source wins (common section 6).
Selector branches the fixtures never reach have only mode-sweep smoke coverage and review.
PocketVerbs is multi-session work; the keep-compiling rule adds overhead but preserves liveness.
Concurrent batch-3 additive shim edits may conflict textually at merge.

portPlanPathRule: For every W2 plan: writePaths = [crates/airwindows/src/plugins/batch2/<gNN> and crates/airwindows/tests/parity_batch2_<gNN>.rs and crates/airwindows/tests/fixtures/batch2/<gNN> for each owned group, the plan file, target, tmp/airwindows-batch2/<planId>]; sharedPaths = []; artifactRoots = [target, tmp/airwindows-batch2/<planId>]; dependsOn = [ab2-00-scaffold]. Verification = commands 1-7 of common section 9 with the plan's groups (each plan file lists them verbatim) plus the mandatory common gate 7b (no 'dead_code' left in owned group dirs). Development rule (S5-M1): declare 'mod <module>;' early so that cargo check compiles it, add '<module>::ENTRY' only when the plugin is complete, keep the shared crate compiling, and wait on sibling breakage only for a bounded time (common sections 5.6 and 8).

acceptanceCriteria: batch2/mod.rs declares mod g01..g34 in numeric order and GROUPS = [g01::ENTRIES, ..., g34::ENTRIES]; every gNN/mod.rs has an empty ENTRIES; the crate compiles (cmd 1).
tools/airwindows-harness/generate_batch2.sh exists, is executable, validates its 110-row table against kick list lines 111-220 and generates all 110 plugins (cmds 2 and 9).

Shim additions, if any, are appended only in a '// batch 2 additions' block and listed with the plugin that needed them, and the batch-1 g03 regeneration is byte-identical (plan cmd 10); or no shim change was needed (recorded).
220 fixture files under crates/airwindows/tests/fixtures/batch2, each .f32 exactly 12,096 bytes, total apparent bytes <= 3,000,000 (cmds 3-5).

tests/catalog_batch2.rs has batch2_fixture_budget, batch2_catalog_exact and batch2_parity_coverage; the budget test passes (cmd 4); the other two fail by design until W2 and are never ignored or softened.
Own-file rustfmt and own-file clippy gates exit 0 (cmds 6-7); the crate-level nextest diagnostic (plan cmd 8) is recorded with only the allowed failures; only writePaths changed (pre/post hashes).
